items.title: Piramal Pharma raises FY27 growth guidance; analysts see 15-23% upside
items.description: Piramal Pharma is experiencing growth momentum as the CDMO business gains traction and expands its late-stage pipeline. It recently upgraded its revenue growth guidance for FY27 to 19-20%. The recent performance reflects a 28% revenue increase and a 72% rise in Ebitda year-on-year. Investments in complex manufacturing are also improving its capabilities in high-value businesses. Analysts remain optimistic, maintaining a 'Buy' rating on the stock.
